item.title: How to get a key cloner in GTA 6
item.description: The key cloner in Grand Theft Auto 6 allows you to steal keyless cars. As the most expensive cars in the game tend to be keyless, unlocking the key cloner is probably high on your priority list, but beware that it'll take a while to meet Randy, the key cloner expert.

item.title: Avengers: Doomsday Will Officially Bring Back One of the MCU's Best Heroes
item.description: The Avengers are set to get a little more help in December's Avengers: Doomsday . In an Instagram post on Sunday, Hailee Steinfeld confirmed she would return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe as Kate Bishop/Hawkeye while promoting her new movie Hexed . In the video, she pans to a director's chair with her name on it, like how the Doomsday cast was initially revealed in an hours-long stream last year.

item.title: Star Wars’ Most Divisive Director Officially Addresses a Possible Return
item.description: There's no question that 2017's Star Wars: The Last Jedi is the most controversial of the franchise's many films. Depending on who you ask, it is either the very best or very worst Star Wars has to offer. That has made director Rian Johnson (also known for the Knives Out movies) something of a hot topic in the fandom. Nearly a decade after The Last Jedi , Johnson has now spoken out about how he feels about Star Wars and whether he — like Palpatine — would ever return to the series.

item.title: GTA 6's First Official Post-Release Update Has A Catch
item.description: It hasn't quite been a whole week since the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 , but the game already has an update to download. Here's what you need to know about developer Rockstar Games' update for the open-world crime epic and how it differs between PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X.

item.title: Avengers: Doomsday’s Final Trailer Is Here, and It Finally Gives Us a Reason to Care
item.description: Avengers: Doomsday is now just weeks away, and Marvel Studios continues to build hype with a new trailer for this year's highly anticipated Avengers sequel.

item.title: Ridley Scott’s Near-Perfect Sci-Fi Miniseries Defies a Terrible Streaming Trend
item.description: While Blade Runner 2049 was a direct sequel that continued the story of Harrison Ford’s Rick Deckard, Blade Runner 2099 creator and showrunner Silka Luisa focuses more on exploring the franchise’s themes than advancing its plot. Fifty years after the events of the 2017 film, the Replicants once used as slave labor out in space have led an uprising and now rule Los Angeles. Rather than searching for rogue Replicants, Blade Runners brutally enforce order amongst the humans unlucky enough to be trapped on the barely habitable planet. Desperate human fugitive Cora (Hunter Schafer) is offered a chance at a fresh start if she can impersonate a Replicant to steal something from the police evidence room. When Cora discovers a rogue Blade Runner already took her prize, she has to team up with his former partner Olwen (Michelle Yeoh) to find it.

item.title: GTA 6 Streams Hit With Indiscriminate Copyright Claims by Reggaeton Artist
item.description: On Nov. 22, streamers who uploaded their GTA 6 gameplay on YouTube were suddenly hit with a barrage of copyright strikes. They all came from a single source: Colombian reggaeton artist Frank "El Santo."

item.title: 34 Years Later, Quentin Tarantino's Crime Thriller Masterpiece Is Officially Free to Stream
item.description: Rarely does a filmmaker’s first movie also become their breakout hit. Before Jaws made Steven Spielberg a household name, he directed the little-remembered The Sugarland Express . The Coen Brothers started with the indie thriller Blood Simple , then enjoyed a handful of moderately successful films before Fargo exploded. But with Quentin Tarantino, this was not the case.

item.title: 32 Years Later, The Best 'Peanuts' Rerun Comic Strip Is Still an All-Time Classic
item.description: Every comic strip has an evolutionary arc. Every cartoonist changes their style over time as they hone their craft, develop their sense of humor shifts, master their particular style, and/or pander to their audience. Sometimes an early character may all but disappear from the comic , or some incidental member of the cast may take up the spotlight. It's part of the fun of going on archive binges, whether it's old newspaper comics or long-running web series. Comics are living things, and few of them stay in the places where they started.

item.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 ‘A Painted Symphony’ Officially Returns in 2027
item.description: Following a sold-out European tour earlier this year, A Painted Symphony is coming back in 2027 with even more dates and locations. The concert series for Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 will get an encore performance next year with a global tour including the first ever performances in North America. The world tour was announced today with tickets going on sale Sept. 15. It will include Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Fans in Asia, Africa, Australia, and South America are out of luck this time around.
